messages:
sara: Hey infra team — noticed a couple infra PRs are failing CI this morning. GH Actions job `infra/bootstrap-secrets` times out and then atlantis plan hangs trying to acquire the lock. Anyone else seeing this?

mike: seeing same. bootstrap-secrets job started failing ~20m ago, runner logs show repeated `kubectl apply` hanging on `Secret/kms-wrap`.

jon: atlantis output: \`2019/11/11 11:11:11 [ERROR] terraform: Error locking state: ConditionalCheckFailedException: The conditional request failed\` — looks like DynamoDB lock table has a stale entry.

atlantis-bot: FYI: there are 3 pending atlantis plans for `infra/services/*` created by run #482. No one has applied them.

mike: quick check — can someone ssh into the long-lived apply runner and run `aws dynamodb get-item --table-name infra-terraform-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"global/production.tfstate"}}'` to see who holds the lock?

kevin: running now... result shows `Info: Owner: actions-runner-12345`, timestamp: 2025-12-05T08:12:02Z — but that runner was terminated. Looks like lock wasn't cleaned up.

lisa: if lock owner is dead we can force-delete the item, but let's be cautious. pinging @sre-oncall (not in thread) to confirm manual delete window. :eyes:

sara: related: bootstrap secrets job fails because it waits for the cluster (kubeconfig from `infra/provision`) which is blocked behind the atlantis plan that modifies kube resources. Chicken-and-egg.

jon: potential short-term fix: 1) remove the DynamoDB lock item for `global/production.tfstate` 2) rerun atlantis plan for the infra PR that contains the kubeconfig 3) let bootstrap-secrets proceed.

mike: agree. I'll coordinate the lock remove and annotate the atlantis PR so we don't conflict.

infra-ci-bot: Note: GH Actions concurrency group `infra-bootstrap` has `cancel-in-progress: false`. If multiple runs queue up, they won't cancel older runs and can hold resources. Consider switching to `true` to avoid stranded locks.

kevin: good call — we should set `cancel-in-progress: true` on the `infra/bootstrap` workflow and add `concurrency: group: 'infra-bootstrap-${{ github.ref }}'` to limit by branch.

lisa: also found in the job logs: `sops: decryption failed: encryption key not found` — the KMS alias referenced in the secrets repo is `alias/redwood-infra`, which exists but permission denied for GH Actions role. Might be two separate failures hitting at once (KMS perms + stale DynamoDB lock).

sara: plan: 1) wait for SRE OK to delete lock 2) temporarily flip GH Actions concurrency cancel-in-progress to true (on master only?) 3) patch GH Actions runner role to include kms:Decrypt for the alias used by sops 4) re-run the bootstrap job. Anyone object?

jon: no objections. I'll craft the tiny PR to flip concurrency and add a note in the workflow: `# temporary: cancel-in-progress=true to avoid lockstorms`.

mike: I'll coordinate with SRE; if they approve, I'll delete the item: `aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name infra-terraform-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"global/production.tfstate"}}' --condition-expression "attribute_exists(LockID)"` and then trigger atlantis plan.

lisa: after we fix this, we should add a guard: atlantis should run a small pre-check that verifies the k8s cluster kubeconfig is reachable before trying to plan changes that depend on it. If bootstrap job must run before plan, make that ordering explicit in our docs.

sara: agreed. Also adding a runbook step: if atlantis shows locked state and owner is a terminated runner, follow the SRE-approved manual lock removal procedure, then comment `@atlantis-bot unlock-for-canal` to avoid accidental re-lock.

infra-ci-bot: Reminder: you can also enable `workflow_run` to auto-cancel previous bootstrap runs for the same ref. See: https://docs.github.com/actions/using-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions#concurrency

mike: SRE gave verbal OK. Proceeding to delete lock in 2 min and will post here when done.

mike: deleted the item and retriggered the atlantis plan. Plan is now progressing. :tada:

sara: rerunning bootstrap job now; added temporary `cancel-in-progress: true` PR open at internal/actions#987.

jon: confirming atlantis plan finished and shows `kubeconfig` change only. Applying should be safe.

lisa: once apply completes, we should verify `kubectl get secret kms-wrap -n infra` exists and decrypts via sops locally.

mike: apply done, bootstrap job now completes. We'll revert the `cancel-in-progress` change to a longer-term solution after we audit runner lifecycle and KMS roles. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sara: filing follow-up tasks: TASK-456 add atlantis pre-check, TASK-457 audit GH runner termination hooks, TASK-458 update runbook with manual lock removal steps. Closing this thread once PRs merge.

infra-ci-bot: linked tasks TASK-456,TASK-457,TASK-458 to this thread.
